patches.name: native-pdf-resolver-queue
patches.adaptation: Host XPCOM/file/browser interfaces injected; per-item cancellation and automatic preference; native not-before times shared between project jobs and renewed on a resumed slot.

patches.name: native-metadata-http-retry
patches.adaptation: Exact retry branches, native delay generator; Node request transport and cancellation replace XHR/security UI interfaces.

patches.name: native-header-decoding
patches.adaptation: ES module export, inactive debug logger; unchanged encoding parser.

patches.name: native-translation-without-reporting
patches.adaptation: Automatic translator failure reporting removed physically; base translation completion retained.

patches.name: reviewer-v3-identifier-enrichment
patches.adaptation: Frozen V3 source copied with application identity, References item IDs and safe provider errors; exact abstract rules retained.

patches.name: native-import-collection-mapping
patches.adaptation: Original native collection hierarchy and item mapping algorithm; injected collection objects produce a scoped persistence plan committed by the existing SQLite adapter in bounded pages.

patches.name: native-metadata-export
patches.adaptation: Native ExportEndpoint preparation and unchanged Node ItemGetter field conversion retained. A private versioned JSONL spool supplies its synchronous length/shift input contract. Exact native format output goes to a private expiring receipt through the native IO.Write host, then the shared authorized file sender. Explicit file-copy requests remain unsupported by metadata export; project Bibliography remains available through Files.

patches.name: native-capture-session-note
patches.adaptation: Exact native note-update method; injected version-guarded project item/save/erase host. Stable session note keys recover a lost save acknowledgement.

patches.name: native-export-file-streams
patches.adaptation: Pinned IO.Write block and BOM constants retained unchanged inside an injected module. Worker-local Node file/converter streams replace XPCOM streams with the existing iconv-lite dependency. JSONL input feeds unchanged ItemGetter one record at a time; one native translator invocation, shared-flag cancellation and explicit native whole-array/graph/DOM memory notices. Native close errors are surfaced after completion and partial private files are removed.

patches.name: native-item-extra-preservation
nativeMethods: Item.fromJSON field/default and base-field/RDF deduplication branches
patches.adaptation: Preserve only fields discarded by object-only itemToAPIJSON. Native Extra branches and formatter copied; valid-field conversion remains unchanged. Missing core accessors derive base-field IDs/type mappings from the already loaded pinned cachedTypes schema; no additional schema or DOI-specific mappings.

patches.name: native-attachment-filenames
patches.adaptation: Exact pinned author/year/title default template and naming methods; JSON item/date/schema and CommonJS exports replace unavailable desktop Item/XPCOM module interfaces. UTF-8 and path byte limits use native truncation.
